facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice woke up from her dream. She learned many things. Children notice what adults miss. Children see differently.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice finally woke up from her dream under the big tree. She told her sister about all the amazing things she saw. Wonderland was a place where nothing followed the usual rules. Children see differently and notice things that adults walk past. Alice had questioned everything because she saw with fresh eyes. Sometimes the youngest person in the room is the wisest one.
facts.Word cards: differently = 다르게 / world = 세상 / children = 아이들 / grown-ups = 어른들
